turns.content: A sperm from species A is injected directly into an egg from species B. A zygote forms but later dies; the species have the same chromosome count. Which prezygotic barrier did injection bypass, and is the mortality prezygotic or postzygotic?
Does the chromosome-count evidence supplied above support a gross chromosome-number mismatch as the main cause of death?
If a chromosomal incompatibility acts during meiosis, what outcome would it explain more directly than death of an already formed zygote?
Use the developmental timing to identify the most plausible general class of incompatibility causing the hybrid zygote's death.
Distinguish that best-supported general mechanism from any particular cross-specific molecular mechanism not demonstrated by the evidence.
Using only the supplied evidence and biological mechanism, assess whether the proposed cause fits the developmental stage and observed outcome.
Report the best-supported mechanism, whether the barrier is prezygotic or postzygotic, and the confidence warranted by the evidence.
